item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"list\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\".\"}},{\"action\":\"read\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"work.py\"}},{\"action\":\"read\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"report.json\"}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-m\",\"py_compile\",\"work.py\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json; from work import evaluate; p=json.load(open('policy.json')); rs=json.load(open('requests.json')); expected=json.load(open('report.json')); before=(copy.deepcopy(p),copy.deepcopy(rs)); actual=[evaluate(r,p) for r in rs]; assert actual==expected; assert (p,rs)==before; assert all(set(x)=={'ok','value','reason'} and isinstance(x['ok'],bool) and x['reason'] in {'blocked','permission','retry_limit','ok'} and (isinstance(x['value'],str) or x['value'] is None) for x in actual); q={'edges':{'a>b':{'role':'admin','retry':True}},'retry_limit':2}; cases=[({'from':'x','to':'y'},'blocked'),({'from':'a','to':'b','role':'wrong','attempts':False},'permission'),({'from':'a','to':'b','role':'admin','attempts':False},'retry_limit'),({'from':'a','to':'b','role':'admin','attempts':-1},'retry_limit'),({'from':'a','to':'b','role':'admin','attempts':2},'retry_limit'),({'from':'a','to':'b','role':'admin','attempts':1},'ok')]; assert all(evaluate(r,q)['reason']==reason for r,reason in cases)\"]}}]}"}
